title: 2027 Ogilvy Creative Summer Internship (New York)
location: New York, NY (hybrid, 3–4 days in office)
note: New York version of the creative-craft internship, with art director and designer tracks (plus copywriter); portfolio link required and US work authorization needed.

facts.duties: Ten-week creative internship working on live client briefs with the agency's creative teams, with mentorship; tracks for art directors, copywriters and designers across Ogilvy, Ogilvy Health and Grey.
facts.requirements: 18 or older with current and future US work authorization; portfolio or work sample link required; must live within commuting distance of the office by June; full-time, 3–4 days a week in the office.
facts.apply: Apply on the Ogilvy careers posting by January 19, 2027, 11:59 p.m. ET, with a portfolio link.
